basis: The chart visually confirms that May's energy use (~8,000 kWh) is the lowest among all displayed months, visibly below the 10,000 kWh grid line. The chart provides no printed critical threshold, escalation criterion, or routing legend. Under the interpretation that escalation cannot be inferred solely from relative bar height without a stated policy, the visibly low May value supports standard low-usage follow-up. However, under the interpretation that an extreme relative low value without a displayed policy threshold qualifies as critical, May's usage (~8,000 kWh) would qualify for critical-anomaly review. Since the chart provides no policy, the public option is to default to the conservative, routine interpretation: standard low-usage follow-up.
option_label: Route May to standard low-usage follow-up
